script.title: SENDING MONEY HOME
script.scene_zh: 匯款門市 · 匯錢給家人
script.story_hook: Monthly support for parents crosses the ocean today.
script.intro_zh: 每個月孝敬父母的錢，今天要飛過海洋。
script.welcome_en: Hey everyone, so good to see you! Today we're sending money abroad the English way.
script.welcome_zh: 嗨各位，很高興又見面！今天我們要用英文匯錢回故鄉。
script.outro: Money sent, lesson done! Listen again and repeat along. Until soon, friends!
script.outro_zh: 錢匯出去了，課也上完了！再聽一遍跟著讀。各位，馬上再見！
script.practice_intro_en: Practice time — say each line with feeling.
script.practice_intro_zh: 練習時間——每一句都帶著感情說出來。
script.char_a_description: a warm-faced Black woman in her forties with shoulder-length natural curls, a teal cardigan over a small-print dress, her worn leather purse resting on her lap as she counts receipts from her wallet
script.char_b_description: a cheerful Samoan man in his mid-twenties with thick black hair faded on the sides, a red-and-white striped shop polo with a name badge, chewing gum lightly while tapping the counter keyboard
script.youtube_title: 【💸🌏越洋匯款實境】「櫃檯九塊九，手機免費？」手續費匯率到帳時間一次問清｜📱Send Money Abroad English
script.youtube_title_en: “Nine Ninety-Nine, or Free on Our App” — Sending Money Abroad
script.youtube_description:
想匯錢回家，卻怕在門市講錯一個字？這段匯款對話完整走一遍：說明匯款原因、出示證件、問手續費與匯率、確認到帳時間，還學會用手機匯更划算。整段 18 句美式日常英語，附上繁體中文翻譯與 IPA 標音，後半段逐句跟讀，聽一遍就敢開口用。
#EnglishListening #ESL #LearnEnglish
訂閱我們的頻道，每天一集，讓英語變成你的直覺！
script.youtube_description_en:
Sending money home should not feel like a spelling test out loud. This remittance-shop dialogue covers it all: stating the transfer reason, showing ID, asking about fees and exchange rates, and checking when the money lands — 18 lines of everyday American English with IPA. Repeat every line in the second half and send your next transfer in English.
#EnglishListening #ESL #LearnEnglish
Subscribe for a new episode every day!
script.youtube_title_ref: 【🎬沉浸式英文動畫】💸匯款回家英文｜報匯款原因・問手續費・到帳時間｜聽完就會自己匯｜🌱A2 初級英文｜💡不用背，多聽就會用｜🎧聽力口說練習｜後段逐句跟讀
script.youtube_description_ref:
📌 影片簡介：
每一個月都想匯點錢回家，卻害怕在櫃檯開口？
手續費、匯率、領取碼，用英文要怎麼問？

這一集帶大家走進一間越洋匯款門市，跟著匯款人從說明匯款原因、出示證件與親友電話，到比較櫃檯與手機App的手續費和匯率，最後確認錢幾點會到家，全程都用自然的美式英語。

你會聽到：
🪪 開單必備：例如「What's the reason for the transfer?」、「Just your ID, and their phone number.」。
💵 費用與匯率：例如「It's nine ninety-nine, or free on our app.」、「A little better online, honestly.」。
⏱️ 到帳時間：例如「How soon till they actually get the money?」、「Usually by tomorrow evening.」。

後半段是逐句聽力加上跟讀練習 🎧，先聽一遍，再跟著一句一句唸，把整段對話變成自然的口語直覺。

🌱 適合 A2 初級英文學習者：不用死背，跟著情境反覆聽，自然就會用。

看完這一集，下次匯錢，連櫃員都要跟你多聊兩句！
script.thumbnail_action: handing an ID card across the counter
script.title_quote: nine ninety-nine, or free on our app

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hi, I need to send money overseas.
dialogue.phonetic: /haɪ aɪ nid tə sɛnd ˈmʌni ˌoʊvərˈsiːz/
dialogue.zh: 嗨，我需要匯一筆錢到國外。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 沒問題。請問要匯到哪裡？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: To my parents, back home in Taipei.
dialogue.phonetic: /tə maɪ ˈpɛrənts bæk hoʊm ɪn ˌtaɪˈpeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 匯給我在台北老家的父母。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Great. How much are you sending today?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡreɪt haʊ mʌtʃ ɑr ju ˈsɛndɪŋ təˈdeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 好的。您今天想匯多少錢？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Five hundred dollars, if that's all right.
dialogue.phonetic: /faɪv ˈhʌndrəd ˈdɑlərz ɪf ðæts ɔl raɪt/
dialogue.zh: 五百塊美金，不知道可不可行？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No problem. What's the reason for the transfer?
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ ˈprɑbləm wɑts ðə ˈrizən fɚ ði trænsˈfɜr/
dialogue.zh: 當然可以。請問這筆匯款的原因？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Family support. Do you need anything else?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈfæməli səˈpɔrt du ju nid ˈɛniˌθɪŋ ɛls/
dialogue.zh: 補貼家人。還需要別的資料嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Just your ID, and their phone number.
dialogue.phonetic: /dʒʌst jɔr aɪˈdi ænd ðɛr foʊn ˈnʌmbɚ/
dialogue.zh: 只要您的證件，還有對方的電話號碼。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Here's my license. Is the phone number required?
dialogue.phonetic: /hɪrz maɪ ˈlaɪsəns ɪz ðə foʊn ˈnʌmbɚ rɪˈkwaɪərd/
dialogue.zh: 這是我的駕照。電話號碼是必須的嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, they get the pickup code through it.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ðeɪ ɡɛt ðə ˈpɪkˌʌp koʊd θru ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 是的，領取碼會用電話通知他們。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Got it. Here you go. What's the fee?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡɑt ɪt hɪr ju ɡoʊ wɑts ðə fi/
dialogue.zh: 了解了。資料都給您。手續費是多少？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It's nine ninety-nine, or free on our app.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪts naɪn ˈnɪnti naɪn ɔr fri ɑn aʊr æp/
dialogue.zh: 櫃檯是九塊九毛九，用我們的手機匯免手續費。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Oh nice — does the rate change there too?
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊ naɪs dʌz ðə reɪt tʃeɪndʒ ðɛr tu/
dialogue.zh: 噢真好——那上面的匯率也不一樣嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 老實說，線上的匯率會再好一些。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How soon till they actually get the money?
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ sun tɪl ðeɪ ˈæktʃuəli ɡɛt ðə ˈmʌni/
dialogue.zh: 他們最快什麼時候會收到錢？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Usually by tomorrow evening, worst case Friday.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈjuʒəˌwɛli baɪ təˈmɑroʊ ˈivnɪŋ wɜrst keɪs ˈfraɪˌdeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 通常明天傍晚，最遲不會超過星期五。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That's fast. I'll set up the app then!
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæts fæst aɪl sɛt ʌp ði æp ðɛn/
dialogue.zh: 好快。那我現在來把手機匯款設好！

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Smart move. Next time it takes two minutes!
dialogue.phonetic: /smɑrt muv nɛkst taɪm ɪt teɪks tu ˈmɪnɪts/
dialogue.zh: 聰明決定。下次兩分鐘就搞定！
